summary: CNH Industrial Capital America LLC filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for a debt offering of % Notes due , underwritten by BofA Securities, Deutsche Bank, Goldman Sachs, Santander, Intesa Sanpaolo, Mizuho, UniCredit, and Wells Fargo. The notes are senior unsecured obligations guaranteed by two direct subsidiaries, with no listing on any exchange. Interest is payable semi-annually, and the notes may be redeemed at the issuer's option or repurchased upon a change of control triggering event. This is a routine capital markets transaction with no special-situation attributes identified.
